name: Post-shock intraday retrace-then-continuation + next-session fade (ten ETFs, 1-min, 2020-01 → 2026-07, as scoped)
provenance: THE scoped test. Data gate re-opened 2026-09-02: Alpaca SIP (existing key) serves full RTH minute sessions from 2016 — verified live on 2016-03-01/2018-02-05/2020-03-16/2022-06-13 before sealing; the repo's 2-year-wall note was wrong. No purchase. HYP-111a (2023-06+) is a strict sub-window of this test and its result is known: the fade, not the path. That knowledge is declared here; it shaped the SECONDARY claim, not the primary, which is byte-for-byte the scope frozen in 0925bd9 before any minute bar.
thesis: After a top-decile |return| day, session t+1 shows a retrace against the shock to 0.382 of the shock-day range followed by a reclaim of the shock-day close and continuation in the shock direction; trading that path beats naive continuation.

data.intraday: Alpaca SIP 1-min, adjustment=all, RTH 09:30-15:59 ET (research/hyp111/alpaca_1m.py), cached data/cache/alpaca_1m_rth/
data.abort: any instrument with < 80% of event sessions having >= 370 RTH bars, or pooled triggered n < 100

power_statement: ~1,798 instrument-events on ~670 dates (scope §1). HYP-111a measured a 12.8% trigger rate on its sub-window → expect ~230 path trades on ~200 dates for the primary: SE ≈ 0.05%/trade, 80% power at ≈0.14%/trade — the primary is thin by construction. The secondary (fade on ALL events) has ~670 dates: SE ≈ 0.04%/event-day, 80% power at ≈0.11%. 2020 is 22% of dates and the regime the fade has never seen.

shock.rule: abs(r_t) >= p90 of trailing 252 |r|, t excluded, per instrument; s = sign(r_t)

path.retrace: first bar reaching L against s (open beyond L counts at 09:30)
path.reclaim: first later bar closing back on the shock side of C, at or before 14:30 ET
path.entry: open of the next bar, direction s, one trade per instrument-event
path.exit: stop at L (both in one bar -> stop) | target at T | time exit 15:55 bar close

costs.note: 2bp spread + 1bp slip, every executed trade, both series; break-even reported only

incumbent.name: naive post-shock continuation
incumbent.rule: direction s from the 09:30 open to the 15:55 close on every instrument-event, same costs
incumbent.why: what the momentum trader does without the path; the delta isolates the path

delta_series: per event date: mean over shocked instruments of (structure_net - naive_net); annualised by sqrt(event dates per year)

confluence.c1: shock-day volume >= 1.5x median of trailing 20 sessions
confluence.c2: session t+1 open on the shock side of C
confluence.c3: close at tau2 on the shock side of session-to-date VWAP
confluence.c4: proxy (SPY; QQQ for SPY) 09:30->tau2 return has sign s
confluence.c5: close_t in the shock-side 25% of range_t
confluence.buckets: <=1 / 2 / >=3; MONOTONIC iff bucket means weakly increase AND OLS slope on count has date-block CI > 0; any bucket < 30 trades -> INCONCLUSIVE

statistics.bootstrap: date-block stationary, L=5, 10000 draws, seed 42, all same-date rows co-resampled (research/hyp111/date_bootstrap.py)
statistics.cpcv: sovereign/discovery/cpcv.py 6/2 over event dates, embargo 1 date

dsr.on: Sharpe of the delta series, n_obs = event dates

components.b1: Sharpe(delta) date-block 95% CI excludes 0 from above

secondary_claim_fade.what: the unconditional next-session fade: −naive_net on every instrument-event (the HYP-111a incumbent, negated)
secondary_claim_fade.pass: date-block 95% CI of mean fade per event-day excludes 0 from above AND >= 7/10 instruments mean > 0 AND 2020-only mean fade CI does not exclude 0 from BELOW (i.e. 2020 does not refute it) AND ex-2020 mean > 0
secondary_claim_fade.floor: none — this is a conditioning claim; the per-deployed-capital denominator is recorded in HYP-113 floor_note_standing and would be sealed by a later strategy prereg

verdict_ladder.INCONCLUSIVE: data abort OR fold error OR (c 8-11) OR (g == 6) OR b2 fails alone OR x fails alone
verdict_ladder.NULL: b1 fails OR c <= 7 OR g <= 5
verdict_ladder.confluence: separate line MONOTONIC / STORY / INCONCLUSIVE, no weight on the primary

operator.most_likely_failure: data gate fails (it did on ThetaData; Alpaca re-opened it)

claude.prior: primary VALID_BUT_BELOW_FLOOR (as 111a); secondary FADE_FAILS on the 2020 component — the fade is liquidity provision and March 2020 is where it gets paid in drawdown

abort.no_scan: no search across fractions, deadlines, costs or subsets
